common.tooManyRequests: Too many attempts. Try again later.

landing.title: A workshop that races while you’re away
landing.subtitle: Rebuild wrecks, match the car to the track and come back for the rewards. Start in a minute, no sign-up.
landing.accountDeleted: Your account was deleted, with everything in it.
landing.noEmail: No e-mail needed. Secure your account later.
landing.imageAlt: The workshop in Złomowo at dusk and three wrecks in the yard

match.title: The right car for the track
match.text: Off-road, drag, hairpins, rain. Every city asks for a different car and different tires.

grow.title: A garage that grows
grow.text: Parts, rarity, a workshop, mechanics and more cities. Progress runs on timers.

idle.title: Races go on without you
idle.text: Come back after an hour or after a day and collect your rewards. The cars keep driving as long as they have fuel.

create.title: What should we call you, driver?
create.consent: By creating a driver you accept the {terms} and the {privacy}.
create.intro: Other drivers will see this name in the rankings and on the sign of your workshop.
create.noAccount: You need no account and no e-mail. You can secure your profile later, once you have earned your first money.

garage.tierUnlocked: You can mount T{tier} parts now.

choose.title: Choose your wreck
choose.subtitle: You will buy the rest of your cars later. This choice is not final.
choose.loadError: The wrecks could not be loaded.

banner.fuel_empty: The tank is empty. The car stands until you refuel it.
banner.breakdown: The car broke down. It stands until it is repaired.
banner.workshop: The car stands in the workshop while the mechanic works. It drives again when the last job is done.
banner.travel: The car is on its way to {city}, arriving in {time}. It earns nothing on the road.
banner.parked: The car is waiting in the garage. It earns nothing until you send it out with Start.

refuel.noCash: Not enough cash to buy fuel.

repair.noCash: Not enough cash to repair the car.
repair.doneRunning: Repaired for {cost}. The car is back on the track.
repair.notNeeded: The car did not need a repair.

tow.breakdown: You cannot afford the repair. The tow is free, but the car waits {time} before it drives again.
tow.fuel_empty: You cannot afford fuel for a lap. The tow is free: the car waits {time} and leaves with a little fuel.
tow.underway: The car is being towed. It drives again in about {time}.

run.loadError: The state of your car could not be loaded.

recover.title: Restore your driver
recover.description: Enter the recovery code you saved. You can find it in your garage under Save your garage.
recover.intro: Sign in with the account linked to your garage, or use the recovery code you saved.
recover.accountDescription: Use the sign-in you linked to your garage. A link from an e-mail works once, for a short time.

recovery.title: Save your garage
recovery.description: If you clear your browser data or switch devices, this code brings your driver back. Without it a guest account is lost.
recovery.regenerateHint: You already have a code. A new one makes the old one stop working.
recovery.once: It is shown only once. Write it down or copy it and keep it safe.

confirm.claimBody: From now on you can sign in on any device with a link sent to your e-mail.
confirm.invalid: It was already used, it has expired or it is not complete. Ask for a new one.

callback.linkedBody: Your garage is saved. From now on you can sign in with {provider}.
callback.cancelledBody: You did not allow it at {provider}, so nothing was changed.
callback.failed: Something went wrong on the way back from {provider}. Try again.
callback.missingVerifier: This sign-in was not started in this browser, or it took too long. Start it again.
callback.expired: This sign-in has expired or was already used. Start it again.
callback.signedOut: Your session has ended. Sign in to your garage and try again.

account.age: I confirm that I am at least {age} years old.
account.consentRequired: Accept the terms and confirm your age to continue.

errors.emailInvalid: This does not look like an e-mail address.

account.ageUnknown: I confirm that I am old enough to have an account.

linkAccount.title: Save your garage
linkAccount.description: Link an account to get your garage back on another device or after clearing your browser. A guest account without one can be lost.

linkBanner.text: Your garage is not saved yet.

linked.title: Your sign-ins
linked.addDescription: Link one more way to get into this garage, so losing one does not lock you out.

legal.name: Name
legal.loadError: The page could not be loaded.

data.title: Your data
data.description: You can take a copy of everything the game holds about you, or delete your account.
data.downloaded: Saved. The file holds your data, but no recovery code or other secret.
data.deleteWarning: This deletes your driver, your cars, your cash and everything else about your account. It cannot be undone, and nobody can bring it back. Download your data first if you want a copy.
data.confirmLabel: To confirm, type the name of your driver: {name}

shop.title: Shop
shop.intro: Parts for your car. Buy a part here, then put it on in the workshop.
shop.bought: Added to your inventory: {name}. Put it on in the workshop.
shop.loadError: The shop could not be loaded.
shop.getXp: You get XP by driving this car.

note.slot: A random model of the slot you choose, of a random rarity
note.mixed: A part of a random slot, of a random rarity
note.premium: A part of the slot you choose, with better odds of a rare one

workshop.title: Workshop
workshop.mechanic: Mechanic of level {level}: jobs take {cut}% less time.
workshop.queueEmpty: Nothing is waiting for the mechanic.
workshop.standing: The car stands in the workshop and earns nothing until the last job is done.
workshop.inventoryEmpty: No spare parts. Buy some in the shop.
workshop.loadError: The workshop could not be loaded.
workshop.cancelLoses: The work already done is lost, and the part stays where it was.
workshop.cancelAlso: Putting on {part} is cancelled with it.
workshop.cancelledWith: Job cancelled, and putting on {part} with it.

tutorial.skipText: You will lose the rewards of the steps still ahead, and K. will stop writing.
tutorial.rewardCarXp: K. added {xp} XP to your car.

story.scene1: “Listen, I have to disappear for a while.”
story.scene2: “I’m leaving you the workshop: the keys, the tools and three wrecks.”
story.scene3: “Złomowo lives on racing. Pick a car, rebuild it and drive.”
story.sms: It’s me. Don’t ask. Pick a car, I’ll text you the rest. — K.

ring.towed: The car waits for the tow
ring.stands: The car stands, no lap is in progress

weather.stays: Now: {now}, and the same after the change in {time}.
weather.lap: A lap in this weather: {time}, paying {cash} (dry: {dry}).

board.later: Bots and the ghosts of other drivers come later. For now you race alone.

forecast.title: Forecast
forecast.slower: This weather slows the car by {percent}%. Other tires may help, have a look at the workshop.
forecast.nightNow: Night: laps on this track are {percent}% longer, because it has no lights.
forecast.nightSoon: Night in {time}: laps on this track will be {percent}% longer, because it has no lights.

race.startTitle: The car is waiting in the garage
race.startNote: Tap Start and the car drives lap after lap by itself, also when you are away.

map.title: Map
map.sub: Cities, roads and tracks. The car earns on the track of the city it stands in.
map.label: Map of the cities
map.loadError: The map could not be loaded.
map.noCar: Choose a car first, then you can hit the road.
map.started: The car is on its way to {city}.
map.fitLow: Change the tires or the car
map.locked: Requires player level {required} (you are level {level}). You get XP by driving.
map.blockedNoGarage: You have no garage in {city}. Buy one there first, then the car can go.

fleet.title: Fleet
fleet.loadError: The fleet could not be loaded.
fleet.buyCarNote: The exchange, the dealer and the wrecks are in the city where the car you play stands.
fleet.sellParts: The parts on it go back to your inventory.

sellBlocked.last_car: Your last car stays with you.
sellBlocked.busy: It is on the road or has work in the workshop.

fleet.xpNote: Only the car you play gives you XP. The others earn cash and level themselves.
